notes: Thresholds decide when silence is worth reporting, never what it means. A QUIET verdict is a statement about the data, not a fault claim: an empty sky produces one. Raise a threshold if operators start ignoring the row; lower it if a dead sensor went unnoticed. recovery_dwell_windows must stay above 1.0 or a marginal sensor flaps between OK and QUIET forever (it accumulates exactly one window of apparent health between crossings). stall_threshold_s must stay well above the pipeline tick (default 0.5s).
